title: Add a detail about a person
instructions: Choose the word that links the detail to the noun before it.

parts.prompt: The volunteer ___ repaired the projector showed the others how to test it.

choice_rationales.A: Which is used for things, and a volunteer is a person.
choice_rationales.B: Whose needs a noun after it, such as ‘whose bag’.
choice_rationales.C: Who links the detail to the person and acts as the subject of ‘repaired’.

parts.hint: Is the noun before the gap a person, a thing or a place?
parts.correct_explanation: Who introduces a detail about a person and is the subject of the verb that follows.
